title: Happy Our Sandpiper Vacation Rentals
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - 4 KING suites - Access to the private Seaside beach via the TUPELO or SAVANNAH pavilions - You will have a total of 18 RFID access cards for access to the private beaches in Seaside. - 4 Bikes - Short walk to the beach, community pools, fitness center, tennis courts, croquet lawn and town center - Professionally decorated - Fully stocked kitchen complete with a standard drip coffee maker and Keurig - Observation deck - Sandpiper Linen Program Participant: All linen, bedding and bath, are the highest quality. - There is an additional cost to use the 3 pools and fitness center in Seaside. This charge is optional with Sandpiper Vacation Rentals. The cost for this cottage is $168/day. Please alert us after booking should you wish to add the "Seaside Amenity Passes" to your reservation. Seaside requires the passes to be purchased for the entirety of your stay when ordered. "Happy Our" is located off Forest Street in Seaside! This beautiful 6-bedroom, 6.5-bathroom home can sleep 18 guests and is just steps from the Seaside Town Square, which features upscale, waterfront boutiques and a variety of restaurants. Its notable features include an observation deck with 360-degree views of Seaside and partial Gulf views. There is also a covered porch with picnic seating, 2 living rooms and kitchens, and a bunk room with a private balcony. In addition to its prime location, the home also includes 4 adult bikes that are the perfect mode of transportation for cruising to-and-from the beach and around the bike trails on 30A. The entire home is professionally decorated with stylish, coastal interiors. On the first floor, you'll find a large eat-in kitchen with premium appliances and designer finishes. The breakfast bar area has informal seating for 8, while the dining table has seating for 10. The connected living area features a fireplace, flat-screen TV, and cozy seating area with plenty of natural light shining in from multiple French doors. There is one primary bedroom suite down the hall with a king bed and a private bathroom with an oversized walk-in shower and bathtub. There is also a full-size washer and dryer in the laundry room on this floor. Upstairs, there is a second primary bedroom suite which also has a king bed and private bathroom attached with a clawfoot bathtub and matching shower as the first room--perfect for soaking after a long day at the beach! The next room features a king bed and a private bathroom. There is also a room with a single king bed and a private bathroom and a room with 2 queen beds and a private bathroom down the hall. The third floor hosts an open, secondary living room and kitchen area. The living room has a flat-screen TV, 2 sofas, and a game table, while the kitchen has a sink, beverage refrigerator, and ice maker against a wall of wood cabinets for extra storage. There is a bunk room on this floor that has 2 twin-over-full bunk beds and a private balcony attached. The third-floor bathroom has a walk-in shower and double vanities. Accommodations:(Sleeps 18): FIRST FLOOR: - Bedroom 1: King Bed, Private Bathroom With Shower and Tub Separate, TV SECOND FLOOR: - Bedroom 2: King Bed, Private Bathroom With Shower and Tub Separate, TV - Bedroom 3: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo, TV - Bedroom 4: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only, TV - Bedroom 5: Two Queen Beds, Private Bathroom with Shower Only, TV THIRD FLOOR: - Bedroom 6: Two Twin-over-Full Bunk beds, Shared Bathroom with Shower Only. Second living room on same level with large TV * Additional fees are required to reserve Pickleball and Tennis courts paid directly to the Seaside amenity Center. * Seaside Chapel with Sunday services, Walkable Town Center from rental home including shopping, restaurants and upscale grocery market.
